paragraphs: Rav Gamda and his son Rabbi Chiyya: end of Tamid, 32. Nedarim 50b: he gave money to sailors to buy him something, and they bought him a monkey. It fled into a hole; they dug after it and found a treasure, and gave everything to Rav Gamda.
